content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text decides a pressed-link dispute by noting that the text does not name whose body is the channel rather than weighing the parties' chains by footing.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "‘weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse’ — one reading permits an underdetermined result from a verse's silence; the other requires comparing the exhibited chains' footings before so ruling.", "why": "It rests the underdetermined ruling on an absent explicit naming, the verse-by-verse/word-for-word test K-C retires, without chain-against-chain footing."}
